full_page.content:
Page 88
Nov. 16th Thomas O'Sullivan - 3 of Pt. Huron - lukemia - has had 28 blood trans- fusions; listless: whole family depressed - Spleen enlarged abnormal
Mrs. Routhier - 56 - baptized Catholic - brought up presbiterian; wants to get back .... also her daughter -- -
Andrew Shandor - 39 - Greek Cath (Roman) .... peculiarly numb. Started last May in lower lip, now all through limbs ... Wife promises more fre- quent Com.
Sheila Brusden - 10 mo. - only child after twelve years praying for family
Mrs. Irene Authier - 36 - Thanks - had T.B. of Spine for four years. Enrolled Oct. 31 - two weeks Monday - is 100%
Stella Trandall - 37 - Stroke in February - 2nd one in October. .. Mrs. McNash - in Guardian Angel - Brain tuomer. ..
Page 89 Nov. 16th Patrick Cotter - 69 - Stomach cancer feared - Ralph's Father - See April 24 '34
Thanks .... Jerome Hallman - 10 - Ostimolitis since four yrs. old: had 19 operations. Enrolled in Ser. Mass Asso'n three weeks ago: loss of leg expected at that time. Now seemingly out of danger. Enrolled To- night as perpetual -
17 Jean Bach - 12 - of Minneapolis, bone sist in arm - twice broken - is quite improved since prayed - Father not Cath.
Mary Jane Dorey - 45 - graduate nurse Harper Hosp. Alice Mary Strong - 4 - Brain tuomer - Providence Hospital Mrs. B. Thompson - 57 - lutheran - ostimelitis - lost breast 3 yrs. ago now gone to bone.
Page 90 Nov. 19th John Elliott - 8 - seems to have ....? possibly lukemia; since Oct. 25th has had 17 blood-transfusions
